treatment_summary.value: Lymph node surgically resected at age 3; transfusion for pancytopenia at 7.5 years; hydroxychloroquine, mycophenolate mofetil, prednisone and rituximab (two 500 mg doses at age 10) added for SLE-like flares (ages 8-11); MMF discontinued and broad spectrum antibiotics at age 11 for neutropenic fevers; HCQ continued and prednisone tapered off at ages 12-14; monthly IVIG replacement started for hypogammaglobulinemia and recurrent infections; at age 15 escalation with prednisone, MMF (1,000 mg twice daily) and two 1000 mg doses of rituximab plus ongoing HCQ and monthly IVIG, with improving lymphadenopathy

parental_testing_statement.value: Whole exome sequencing of this patient and both parents also revealed that this patient’s mutation is a de novo mutation, as neither parent harbors the p.Q593X pathogenic variant.

functional_evidence_statement.value: None performed: biochemical studies have not been performed to test formally whether the mutation leads to increased TNF-alpha-associated NF-kB activity
